china_race_dynamics.text: It is also important that we maintain our technological superiority over China so we can ensure Americans’ private data, crucial digital infrastructure systems, and our national security interests continue to be protected. [...] If we want to win the AI race with China, we need to enable innovation in the domestic artificial intelligence market, and comprehensive regulation lets us do just that.
